svg.title: Production REST API Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing the layers: Client, API Gateway/HTTPS, Express middleware, routes, services, data layer, MySQL, and cross-cutting concerns

sendPrompt('What business logic belongs in the TaskService?')
